labels.justification: Both preach generosity through a firefly, but A's tangled 'The ___ One' names and abrupt POV shift undercut its moral, while B states the lesson more directly via the owl's advice despite its own repetitive, garbled sentences.

Both orangutan fables build toward accepting differences after a rumor-driven falling out, but each is weakened by contradictory character motivations and an incomplete final sentence, landing at comparable quality.
Both center a helpful seal, but B's storm-and-market plot resolves the friendship moral more coherently, while A's singing-mural resolution stays largely nonsensical.
A collapses into invented gibberish words and an unexplained book subplot before cutting off mid-sentence, while B keeps a more legible, if still garbled, unity arc around a storm and an Oak Tree.

A spirals through unexplained new animals (rabbits, mice, raccoons) and broken grammar to an incomplete ending, whereas B sustains a single leopard-fox-owl fairness conflict despite repetition glitches like 'fox and fox and fox'.
